plan.selection: Four fresh full papers before reading student answers or teacher marks. Primary denominator: readable student responses; frozen paired predictions before scoring. Exact matches per readable answer should increase without increasing one-point disagreements per readable answer.

policy_selection.additional_arm: For bundled ML only, additionally refer marks <=1 using existing Policy.written_review_at_or_below. Compare this operating point on the same frozen candidate proposals. Set as stock default only if exact matches per readable response exceed baseline, one-point errors per readable response do not exceed baseline, and it offers at least as many proposals as baseline. Prefer the unrestricted candidate if it meets the original gates with no more large errors than the conservative arm. Otherwise retain the prior grader or show experimental configuration. For new exams keep teacher-defined rubric and the independent assessment.
policy_selection.basis: eval/written_review_policies.json and previous five-paper development results. Added after implementation, before fresh teacher outcomes were opened.

groups.conservative: additional existing cutoff 1 applied to alt-candidate; confirmed blanks excluded from readable denominator
